warning_texts: The frozen check_plan has no rule that the period string on a claim equals audit_spec population.period, and claims_recomputed applies the plan's own between-filter, so a shifted period on CLM-NET-CZ can pass the machine gate while the register labels a different window.

summary: CLM-NET-CZ value 13527.24 is CZ delivered net on the spec window 2025-01-01..2025-03-30 from raw_data/orders.csv, but analysis/claim_register.json labels that claim 2025-01-01..2025-02-28, whose CZ delivered net is 9248.36 (43 rows; 19 March rows add 4278.88). The other four claims recompute from raw on the spec period, independent_claim_recalc.json is rooted only in raw_data/orders.csv, and CLM-REFUND-RATE caveats name paying_customers.
